component.name: ebaner
component.summary: Drive trains on the Norwegian railways
Kjør tog på det norske jernbanenettet

description.p: ebaner is a railway simulator. Trains are driven over the line as it actually is, with the terrain, the track and the gradients taken from an export of the national survey data rather than drawn by hand.
What the train does on the line is modelled rather than scripted:

ul.li: A continuous air brake that has to be kept charged, and that feels how long the train is - a 600 m freight is slow to apply and slow to let go
Traction worked out from each machine's own transmission, from a torque converter to a generator and traction motors
Couplers that part and re-couple, so a locomotive can run round its train
Track circuits, signals, interlocked routes and line blocks
A driver the computer can take over from, obeying the signals and the limits
Every train in the world simulated, not only the one being driven

description.p: The terrain export is large and is installed separately; ebaner looks for it in the usual places, and the EBANER_DATA environment variable overrides them.
